stripe is 1+1 as a two-node cluster (clusterMode Dual): one copy on each of the two workers, so the cluster survives the loss of either; data migration after a failure runs in relaxed placement, so it needs no third node. Outside clusterMode Dual every redundant scheme needs at least three storage nodes. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
enableNodeAffinity is set, because a 1+1 stripe is a mirror and reads are served from the local node's copy first. The control plane takes it at cluster create and never re-applies it, so this is the line to remove now if reads should not prefer the local node
wrote discovered-discover-fleet-08 in Draft: 2 workers with 8 nvme devices, in 1 group(s) across 1 node set(s); 0 refusal(s)
